question:
Simplify:

[(7 (1)/(4))²-(5 (4)/(5))²] div 5 (4)/(5) times (16)/(9)
solution:
**Given:**

[(7 (1)/(4))²-(5 (4)/(5))²] div 5 (4)/(5) times (16)/(9)

**Concept used: **

BODMAS Rule, follow the order: Bracket off, Division, multiplication, addition and subtraction.

**Calculation:**

[(7 (1)/(4))²-(5 (4)/(5))²] div 5 (4)/(5) times (16)/(9)

⇒ \(\left[\left( \frac{29}{4}\right)²-\left(\frac{29}{5}\right)²\right]\div \frac{29}{5} \times \fr
